outcome_definitions.surviving_kill: episode has >=1 non-trade kill (causal or physical) with actor alive after it
outcome_definitions.killed_by_bot: episode has >=1 actor death solely sourced by the bot (physical or causal), excluding trades
outcome_definitions.own_bomb: episode has >=1 actor death solely from its own bomb
outcome_definitions.loss: any of killed_by_bot/own_bomb/mutual and no surviving_kill
